title: Zhalia Moon's apartment
summary: Zhalia's apartment was where Zhalia Moon stayed while living in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
After Zhalia sided with the [[Huntik Foundation]] for good, [[The Organization]] sent [[Suits]] to her apartment to eliminate her. Anticipating their attack, she escaped quickly after setting off bomb that blew up her apartment, leading the Organization to believe in her death. {{source|The Unseen Guide}}

'''Zhalia's apartment''' was where [[Zhalia Moon]] stayed while living in [[Rotterdam, Netherlands]]. 

== History ==
After Zhalia sided with the [[Huntik Foundation]] for good, [[The Organization]] sent [[Suits]] to her apartment to eliminate her. Anticipating their attack, she escaped quickly after setting off bomb that blew up her apartment, leading the Organization to believe in her death. {{source|The Unseen Guide}}
